title: Hand Crossbow
summary: Yurgir’s hand crossbow deals 2d10 Piercing. Humanoids cannot equip it.

fields.Weapon profile: Martial, one-handed, Light, ammunition, loading, dippable and 50 ft normal range.
fields.Availability: Obtain only by disarming Yurgir. If he survives the fight with Raphael, picking up his dropped weapons can turn him hostile.
fields.Base value: 50 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
